meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

copy.tagline: 添加 NanoClaw 监控仪表板，定期推送数据快照。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你管理 NanoClaw 并希望实时观测其状态。
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw and stream periodic data snapshots.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a NanoClaw instance and want to watch its metrics on a dashboard.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 装一个本地监控面板,并加一个 pusher:每 60 秒推送一次 JSON 快照,每 2 秒推送日志。面板分页展示 agent 分组、会话、频道、用户、token 用量和实时日志。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 添加监控面板时触发。它会装 npm 包、往 src/index.ts 的 main() 里插入一段启动代码,并改 .env。

howto.what_en: Installs a local monitoring dashboard into NanoClaw plus a pusher: JSON snapshots every 60s, logs every 2s. Pages cover agent groups, sessions, channels, users, token usage and live logs.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add a monitoring dashboard to a NanoClaw project. It installs the npm package, inserts a startup block into main() in src/index.ts, and edits .env.
